	const state = useComplaintData(`/api/complaint-workflow/${id}`, true);
	const { data, token } = state;
	const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
	const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
	const [error, setError] = useState("");
	const pending = useRef(null);
	const act = async (fields) => {
		if (!token || !data || busy) return;
		const signature = JSON.stringify({
			id,
			fields
		});
		if (pending.current?.signature !== signature) pending.current = {
			signature,
			body: {
				...fields,
				requestId: crypto.randomUUID(),
				version: data.complaint.version
			}
		};
		setBusy(true);
		setError("");
		setMessage("");
		try {
			const result = await complaintRequest(token, `/api/complaint-workflow/${id}/actions`, pending.current.body);
			pending.current = null;
			setMessage(result.message);
			state.reload();
		} catch (reason) {
			// A network retry reuses the original ID. A server rejection is safe to correct and resubmit.
			if (reason instanceof Error && "status" in reason) pending.current = null;
			setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Unable to record this action.");
			state.reload();
		} finally {
			setBusy(false);
		}
	};
	const download = async (imageId, fileName) => {
		if (!token) return;
		try {
			const response = await apiFetch(`/api/complaint-workflow/${id}/evidence/${imageId}`, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
			if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Unable to download evidence.");
			const url = URL.createObjectURL(await response.blob());
			const anchor = document.createElement("a");
			anchor.href = url;
			anchor.download = fileName;
			anchor.click();
			window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1e3);
		} catch (reason) {
			setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Unable to download evidence.");
		}
	};
